title: JSON to Go Struct
description: Convert JSON to Go structs with json tags — nested structs, slices and omitempty included.
howto: Click Generate to build the structs.
Copy the code or download types.go.

faqs.a: Each nested object becomes its own named struct, referenced by the parent field.

faqs.q: What do the struct tags look like?
faqs.a: Every field gets a `json:"key"` tag; nullable fields also get `,omitempty`.
As slices — []string, []int, or []NestedStruct. Mixed or empty arrays become []interface{}.
Yes — paste it into any Go file. No imports are needed unless you add time.Time fields yourself.
